_about: English names for concept pages whose label is Latin or another non-English term (24 Nov 2026). Each name is one of the node's own aliases; one model family proposed it and a second accepted it. Nothing here is a translation made for the site. Read by web/build-atlas.mjs for the page title, description and JSON-LD. On 26 Nov 2026 Damian took out nine of the ten names (anima-mundi, anthropos, cynocephalus, deus-absconditus, mater-natura, servator-cosmi, sol-terrenus, unio-mentalis, unus-mundus) and kept lapis.

lapis.label: Lapis philosophorum
lapis.source: an alias of the node in seed.json, mined from the Collected Works
